jobs.occupation: Export Manager - Experience in Toy Sector MANDATORY
jobs.description:
Our client is a fast-growing European company specializing in the design and distribution of innovative products. Since its creation, the company has built a strong international presence.

Driven by creativity, quality, and innovation, the organization develops products that combine learning, entertainment, and everyday practicality. To support its continued international expansion, our client is looking for a motivated and entrepreneurial professional to join its export team.

Jobomschrijving

The Export Manager will be in charge of the following responsibilities :

• Support the implementation of export and international business development strategies across assigned territories.
• Identify, prospect, and develop new business opportunities with distributors, retailers, and international partners.
• Build and maintain long-term relationships with existing customers and distribution networks.
• Participate in commercial negotiations and support the preparation of contractual and pricing agreements.
• Coordinate with supply chain, logistics, customer service, and finance teams to ensure smooth order processing and timely deliveries.
• Analyze market trends, competitor activities, and industry developments to identify growth opportunities.
• Prepare sales forecasts, market analyses, and performance reports.
• Represent the company at international trade fairs, exhibitions, and customer meetings.

• 3 to 5 years of experience in a similar position 
• Experience in Toy Sector (mandatory)
• Good understanding of export processes, international trade regulations, and commercial documentation.
• Strong communication, relationship-building, and negotiation skills.
• Fluent in English; additional languages are considered a strong asset.
• Willingness to travel internationally on a regular basis.

This large Belgian company plays a key role and manages an extensive and technically complex network. Behind the scenes, high-performing and reliable IT systems ensure that operational processes run safely and efficiently. Within this business-critical environment, significant investments are being made in modern software development and sustainable IT architecture.
You will join an experienced team operating in an Enterprise environment where quality, collaboration, and long-term vision are central.

Jobomschrijving

As Lead Full Stack Developer, you take a key role in the further development and evolution of a suite of business-critical applications used in real-time operational environments.
You remain strongly hands-on in both backend and frontend development, working primarily with .NET and Angular, while also guiding technical choices, improving existing implementations and helping shape upcoming solutions. You challenge current approaches where needed and translate complex technical topics into clear and pragmatic proposals.
A major part of the role is technical leadership. You support and coach other developers, promote knowledge sharing and help maintain high standards in code quality, maintainability and software design. You work closely with analysts, architects, testers and other developers within an Agile/Scrum setup.
You also keep a close eye on delivery, scope and technical risks. When dependencies, architectural concerns or implementation issues arise, you identify them early and help the team move towards a robust and sustainable solution.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience in .NET & Angular
•  15 years of experience in IT
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

Our client is a global life sciences organization providing specialized research solutions to pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and healthcare companies. • Prospect and identify new business opportunities using available sales tools and market intelligence.

Our client is a fast-growing private markets investment platform offering investors access to carefully selected private equity opportunities through a diversified fund-of-funds approach.

As an Investment Relations & Fundraising Manager, you will:

• Develop and execute fundraising initiatives to attract new investors across Belgium and Luxembourg.
• Identify, qualify and build relationships with high-net-worth individuals, entrepreneurs, family offices and other private investors.
• Create and maintain a targeted prospect pipeline, defining market priorities and developing effective outreach strategies.
• Present private equity investment opportunities to prospective investors and clearly articulate the investment rationale.
• Lead investor meetings, networking events and fundraising discussions.
• Build trust-based, long-term relationships with existing and prospective investors.
• Act as a key ambassador for the firm's investment solutions and market positioning.
• Work closely with the investment team to gain a deep understanding of underlying funds, portfolio construction and investment strategies.
• Monitor fundraising activity, investor feedback and market developments to support future growth initiatives.
• Contribute to the firm's expansion by identifying new opportunities within the private wealth ecosystem.

The successful Investment Relations & Fundraising Manager has the following profile :

• About 5 years of experience within private banking, wealth management, investor relations, fundraising, private markets or a related investment environment.
• Strong understanding of private equity and alternative investments.
• Previous exposure to fundraising, capital raising or investor acquisition activities is highly desirable.
• Ability to confidently engage with sophisticated investors and explain complex investment concepts in a clear and compelling manner.
• Demonstrates strong interpersonal skills, credibility and executive presence.
• Able to build conviction and establish trust with experienced investors.
• Entrepreneurial, proactive and comfortable working within a growing business.
• Fluent Dutch, French and English is strongly preferred.

Our client, based in Antwerp, is active in logistics.

jobs.occupation: Senior Full Stack Developer – Java & Angular
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Develop and maintain scalable web applications using modern full-stack technologies.
• Deploy and manage containerized services within an Azure Kubernetes Service environment.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to build data spaces and connectivity tools for regional stakeholders.
• Support the design of automated test frameworks and the integration of AI-driven development roadmaps.
• Conduct technical research and proof-of-concepts to evaluate new features for organization-wide rollout.

Requirements

• You have 8+ years of experience in backend development with Java (specifically versions 17 or 21).
• You possess 8+ years of frontend expertise with Angular and HTML5.
• You bring 5+ years of experience with Spring, Spring Boot, and Hibernate.
• You're experienced with software lifecycle tools including Git, Maven, and JUnit.
• You possess 3+ years of experience working with RESTful API and Microservices architecture.
• You have practical experience with containerization using Docker and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
• You have advanced knowledge of Agile methodologies, ideally within a SAFe context.
• You possess a proactive and solution-oriented mindset with an interest in AI-assisted programming.
• You are native or bilingual in Dutch with professional working proficiency in English.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with Azure DevOps and Node.js.
• Knowledge of GIS and GIS data types.
• Familiarity with UX Design & Research principles.
• Knowledge of Reactive Programming or RxJs.
• Experience with MS SQL Server and OAuth.

The Cream recipe
